title: Naive Intervention
coreMove: Pause before relieving a signal and ask what adaptive feedback the discomfort may be carrying.
sourcePressure: This chapter critiques interventions that remove visible pain while increasing hidden fragility and blocking feedback.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating all help, treatment, or intervention as automatically harmful.

sourceAnchors.name: naive intervention
sourceAnchors.detail: intervention can remove visible discomfort while increasing hidden fragility
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The clean fix is suspect when it silences the only alarm the system had.

sourceAnchors.name: signal suppression
sourceAnchors.detail: the source note names blocked adaptive feedback as the central danger
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A muted signal can feel like relief while the damage keeps moving underground.

counterintuition: Treating all help, treatment, or intervention as automatically harmful.
